name: Sree Madapalli
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and meals — dosa, idli, chaat (no onion/garlic on request)
why_it_matters: A clean, reasonably-priced pure-vegetarian restaurant near the Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple in Srirangam — Sree Madapalli serves South Indian food and chaat, and will prepare dishes without onion and garlic on request, which suits temple-town visitors. The most consistently recommended sit-down option inside the Srirangam temple precinct.
insider_tip: Ask for no-onion-no-garlic if you want strictly sattvic food — the kitchen accommodates it. Handy for a meal before or after a long Ranganathaswamy temple visit. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Near Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam, Tiruchirappalli District, Tamil Nadu 620006

name: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple Prasadam
signature_dish: Srirangam puliyodharai (tamarind rice) and thayir sadam (curd rice) prasadam
why_it_matters: The Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple — the largest functioning Hindu temple complex in the world — runs a madappalli (temple kitchen) whose prasadam is famous in its own right. The Srirangam puliyodharai (tamarind rice) and thayir sadam (curd rice) are served warm to devotees through the day; sweet pongal, ven pongal, vadai and laddu rotate through the offerings every 15-20 minutes.
insider_tip: Buy the puliyodharai prasadam at the temple counters — Srirangam's tamarind rice is a celebrated recipe, distinct and worth seeking out. This is temple prasadam, so availability and counters follow ritual hours. Small cash only.
signature_address: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam, Tiruchirappalli District, Tamil Nadu 620006

name: Sri Ammami Mess
signature_dish: Traditional South Indian mess meals on a banana leaf
why_it_matters: A traditional pure-vegetarian mess on Ammamandapam Road in Srirangam, near the Cauvery ghat — Sri Ammami Mess serves home-style South Indian meals, the kind of unpretentious banana-leaf eatery that pilgrims and locals rely on within the temple island.
insider_tip: Mess-style lunch is the order — simple, home-style and cheap. Ammamandapam Road runs toward the river ghat, so easy to combine with a Cauvery visit. Small cash.
signature_address: 70 Sringeri Mutt, Ammamandapam Road, Sriramapuram, Srirangam, Tiruchirappalli District, Tamil Nadu 620006

name: Annalakshmi Restaurant
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin — onion rava dosai with filter coffee
why_it_matters: A small pure-vegetarian tiffin restaurant in Srirangam known for local staples like onion rava dosai and filter coffee — one of the handful of restaurants actually listed in Srirangam on TripAdvisor, a basic but genuine temple-town tiffin stop.
insider_tip: Order the onion rava dosai with a filter coffee for a quick Srirangam breakfast. Basic surroundings — this is everyday temple-town food, not fine dining. Small cash.
signature_address: Srirangam, near Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple, Tiruchirappalli District, Tamil Nadu 620006
